marie (partnerships): FYI — OrionCloud just pinged about a partial SKU swap for our EU marketplace reservations. 1/3 of the A100 shipment hit a customs delay; they're offering B550 equivalents at the same price. Thoughts? :thinking:

sam (logistics): Oof. Which reservation IDs are affected? Any hard ETAs?

marie (partnerships): IDs: R-4432, R-4433, R-4436. ETA shift from ~21 days to ~35 days for the delayed batch. Sheet: https://share.redwood/internal/resv-R4432 (internal)

kevin (finance): If we accept a downgrade swap, finance needs automated credits tied to each reservation until parity is restored. Propose 15% credit on impacted reservations+ a clause for expedited delivery credit. Numbers check?

elaine (prod-ops): B550 will run most batch and embedding workloads fine but realtime chat SLOs for r/chat* will likely regress. We should gate swaps to non-realtime routes unless partner guarantees perf.

marie (partnerships): My read: conditional acceptance only. Allow swap for non-realtime and non-canary customers; require partner to commit to an expedited top-up for 10% of volume & a credit on delayed portion.

ignacio (orion-supply): Hi all — apologies from our side. We can commit to an expedited 10% bump out of our buffer and offer 20% credit on the delayed quantity. We need a soft-yes by EOD to lock manifests. Can we agree to conditional swap + credit?

sam (logistics): If we give a soft-yes, how does manifesting work? Do we PATCH reservation SKU or do we cancel/rebook? Need minimal friction for ops.

marie (partnerships): Proposed quick workaround: PATCH /reservations/{id} with {"partner_swap": "B550", "conditional": true, "credit_notes": "TBD"}. Is that feasible? @ravi (eng-platform)

ravi (eng-platform): We don't currently support a formal sku-swap flag. Short-term hack: we can accept a partner_note and schedule a replan job that maps A100->B550 for specific resv IDs. Not ideal, but doable before EOD if legal signs off.

kevin (finance): OK — finance will draft ledger rules: original commit volume reserved at contract rate, exchanged units billed at market price with a credit line applied. I'll draft addendum language and attach a table of credits per reservation.

elaine (prod-ops): I'll create a canary list and mark routes/routing policies that must not be on downgraded hardware. Sharing the list in #eng-runtime after this thread.

marie (partnerships): Summary: conditional soft-accept if Orion confirms 20% credit on delayed qty + 10% expedited bump. Only allowed for non-realtime routes and non-canary customers. We use partner_note workaround on API until a proper sku_swap field exists. I'll draft the addendum and loop in legal + CS.

ignacio (orion-supply): Confirmed — I will upload amended manifest and credit proposal by 18:00 UTC. Thanks for the quick coordination.

marie (partnerships): Thanks. If we get the manifest and credit terms by EOD, ops can proceed with the partner_note patch and we avoid cancel/rebook churn. :thumbsup:
